name: zoey-memory
description: ZoeyMemory: memory across sessions. Hooks log every user prompt to docs/memory/, load context at session start (recent prompts, last session note, open OpenSpec changes, git log), and auto-pull when safe. Installs superpowers as a dependency; /zoey-memory:init installs the openspec CLI. Run /zoey-memory:init in a new repo to enable.
